project_type: Python FastAPI EDMS (Enterprise Document Management System)
build_system: uv (package manager), no Makefile or Dockerfile currently
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, fixtures in tests/conftest.py using httpx AsyncClient + aiosqlite in-memory DB
verification_instructions: Run uv run pytest tests/ -x -q and confirm all tests pass (baseline 872 + new tests)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Python 3.11.14 pre-installed. Using uv as package manager.
contribution_requirements: Models inherit from Base in app/models/group.py. APIs registered in app/api/router.py. Services in app/services/. Schemas (Pydantic) in app/schemas/. Templates in app/templates/. Auth via get_current_user or require_role() from app/core/security.py.
key_patterns: UUID primary keys for User/Role models, int primary keys for Document/Group. SQLAlchemy async with mapped_column. Pydantic BaseModel for schemas. APIRouter per feature file. Wiki uses filesystem storage. Tests create admin user with _create_admin_user helper. asyncio_mode=auto in pytest config.
directory_structure: app/ (main application): api/ (FastAPI routers), models/ (SQLAlchemy models), schemas/ (Pydantic), services/ (business logic), templates/ (Jinja2 HTML), core/ (config, db, security), middleware/. tests/ (pytest). wiki/ (filesystem wiki storage).
